title: ContentManifestV1
description: One locale's content release (#6 § First paint): which content and data files it consists of, their digests, the renderer release that renders them, and the upstream revisions they were read from. The release ID is content-addressed. Consumers fail closed on an unknown schemaVersion, a wrong locale, a missing file or a digest mismatch.

releaseId.description: sha256 over the sorted `path digest` lines of `files`, so the same content always has the same ID.

rendererRelease.description: The application release (full commit of redact-secret-www) whose renderer produced the HTML.

sources.description: Every upstream the content was read from, at its full revision.

path.description: Relative to the release root; never absolute, never climbing out.

schemaVersion.description: The contract the file validates against.
